 ATF price hiked by Rs 1.37 per litre; commercial LPG cylinder by Rs 10 
 News On AIR | 
 November 1, 2026 1:55 PM 
 ATF price hiked by Rs 1.37 per litre; commercial LPG cylinder by Rs 10
 Aviation turbine fuel ATF prices have been increased by one rupee 37 paise per litre and the commercial LPG rate has been increased by 10 rupees per 19-kg cylinder. ATF prices were increased to 138 rupees 50 paise per litre from 137 rupees 12 rupees per litre. With the increase, the price of a 19-kg commercial LPG cylinder has touched two thousand 820 rupees.  
 The changes by Oil Marketing Companies are based on movements in international benchmark prices and the rupee-dollar exchange rate. ATF and LPG prices are revised on the first day of every month and can vary across states because of local taxes.
